data.description: Bright & Spacious Villa | Luxury Finish | Ideal for Families
data.display_address: Elie Saab 2, Elie Saab, Arabian Ranches 3, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into refined elegance with this exceptional 4-bedroom villa in Elie Saab II at Arabian Ranches 3, where world-class design meets serene community living. Branded by the renowned fashion house Elie Saab, this residence showcases sophisticated interiors, premium finishes, and timeless aesthetics. Designed for those who appreciate luxury and comfort, the villa offers spacious living in a tranquil, family-friendly environment.

Property Highlights:

-4 Spacious Bedrooms
-5 Elegant Bathrooms
-Built-Up Area: 4,923.52 sq. ft
-Branded interiors designed by Elie Saab
-Expansive open-plan living and dining areas
-Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
-Contemporary kitchen with high-end fittings
-Private landscaped garden
-Large balconies and terraces
-Maid’s room
-Covered parking spaces

Property Amenities:

-Gated community with 24/7 security
-Swimming pools and leisure areas
-Fully equipped fitness center
-Landscaped parks and green spaces
-Jogging and cycling tracks
-Children’s play areas
-Clubhouse and community center
-Retail outlets and cafes nearby
-Family-oriented environment

Location Highlights:

-Located in Arabian Ranches 3, one of Dubai’s most sought-after suburban communities
-Easy access to Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
-Close to Global Village and Dubai Outlet Mall
-Approximately 20 minutes to Downtown Dubai
-Around 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport
-Nearby schools, healthcare facilities, and daily conveniences
